t0006-01.gloss: A message and its map both stop short of a destination.
t0006-01.rival_reading: A field delivery could be delayed by a road restriction and leave an unfinished message; the card does not say who issued the instruction.

t0006-02.gloss: A crop sketch and an out-of-season guide sit together.
t0006-02.rival_reading: Someone tracking seasonal conditions during an emergency could keep an old gardening column with field notes; the mismatch does not identify an experimental program.
